tasks.label: Validate All JSON Files
tasks.command: for file in .vscode/*.json .*.json; do [ -f "$file" ] && echo "Checking: $file" && python3 -m json.tool "$file" > /dev/null && echo "✓ Valid" || echo "✗ Invalid"; done

tasks.label: Create New Agent Template
tasks.command:
cat > new_agent.json << 'EOF'
{
  "id": "new_agent",
  "name": "New Agent",
  "description": "Description of what this agent does",
  "model": "gpt-5.1-mini",
  "temperature": 0.5,
  "top_p": 0.95,
  "max_tokens": 2000,
  "entities": [],
  "tools": [],
  "allowed_tools": [],
  "system_prompt": "Use the Better Man Project — Unified Style Guide. You are...",
  "visible": true,
  "tags": []
}
EOF
echo 'Created new_agent.json - customize as needed!'
